method.input: Every nonzero-alpha original512 sword texel center, including alpha1 tails; nearest floor lookup of actual imported original512 helmet/hand sourceRGBA.
method.facing: x=256+Facing*(x_right-256), y unchanged; source helmet/hand mask reflected by the same single operation.
method.layer_order: HelmetForeground then Sword then NearHand; remaining sword alpha=wAlpha*(1-handAlpha/255).
method.core_sample: remaining sword alpha>=128 and actual helmet alpha>=128; any sample:both>0.
method.ground_reference: fixed displayRoot.y464; positive margin means projected sword is above this baseline, not physics-ground proof.
method.source_pixel_cells: Centers + rotation-projected half unit-cell support; no image resampling or mask output.
method.sensitivity: Nine hypothetical±3source palm perturbations only assess measurement sensitivity, never change candidate palm.
method.raster_budget: 1screen pixel subtracted as an UNMEASURED design allowance. Not a proven engine filtering/error bound.
method.not_GPU: No viewport raster/filter/depth/translucency/sampling reproduced; source sample counts are not rendered pixels.

per_facing.mirror_note: Algebraic single reflection and reflected-mask lookup; not two GPU measurements.
